description: This file defines classes and functions for managing fake implementations of operators in PyTorch, including registration, context management, and symbolic size handling.

classes.name: FakeImplHolder
classes.description: A holder for registering and managing fake operator implementations, including kernel registration and deregistration.

classes.name: FakeImplCtx
classes.description: Context object for creating fake operator implementations, providing methods for symbolic size generation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a fake implementation kernel for an operator, with optional override permission.

methods.name: construct_meta_kernel
methods.description: Creates a meta kernel wrapper that manages error handling and context setting for fake kernels.

methods.name: get_none
methods.description: Returns None, used as default context getter.

methods.name: set_ctx_getter
methods.description: Context manager to set a global context getter function.

methods.name: create_unbacked_symint
methods.description: Deprecated method to create a symbolic integer, replaced by new_dynamic_size.

methods.name: new_dynamic_size
methods.description: Constructs a symbolic integer representing a data-dependent size, with bounds.
